en: Vintage black‑and‑white Hungarian postcard. The front shows a pencil drawing of a narrow street lined with simple houses, with a hill densely covered by more buildings and a small chapel on top in the background. A few small figures walk along the street. The artist's signature and the year 1922 appear in the lower right corner. The reverse side is a classic divided back with address lines and a stamp box, printed entirely in Hungarian, mentioning Pécs, Puturlu Street and the Havihegy Chapel, and crediting the artist and printer.
